noEyeSourceBasis: Their previously viewed complete source frames contain landscapes, blue butterfly graphics, or strictly back-facing illustrated women; original scene references rechecked. No front-facing printed expression is present.

withdrawn.reason: Generated narrowed or closed expression was incorrectly accepted as original; actual original scene/master have open eyes. Rejected, replacement pending.
Late tilt and pronounced eye narrowing cannot confidently be certified as faithful fixed print geometry. Rejected under strengthened fidelity requirement; separate early-interval candidate pending.

faultyOldMotionReferences.finding: First actual input motion frame already has generated closed/narrow eyes.

motionReferenceCoverage: S17 first frame and S11/S36/S43 three full-frame samples each; these failures need no all-frame claim. Not an exhaustive new review of every old motion reference.

scope: Partial actual fidelity re-review during production. No final film acceptance, no human full playback, no automatic approval of later model output. Remaining sources and 2K require separate actual review.
